name: Original crafted poison: instrumented cold active recipient and paused inventory

files.content:
replace=config
replace=data
resources="{resources}"
data="{oblivion_data}"
content=Oblivion.esm
start=ImperialDungeon01
skip-menu=1
new-game=0
no-grab=1
user-data="{output}/userdata"
data-local="{output}/test-data"
content=tutorial-passage-observer.omwscripts

[Video]
resolution x = 1280
resolution y = 720
fullscreen = false
framerate limit = 60
[General]
screenshot format = png

[Input]
enable controller = true

[GUI]
controller menus = false

[Input]
camera sensitivity = 0.5

local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local frames=0
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function()
 frames=frames+1;if frames%3~=0 then return end
 assert(not Actor.isDead(self),'Player died during actual crafted poison continuation')
 local target=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x3b513))
 assert(target and target:isValid(),'Original poison recipient missing')
 print('CraftedTarget health='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(target).current..' dead='..tostring(Actor.isDead(target))..' paused='..tostring(core.isWorldPaused())..' player='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current)
end}}}}
